_: Mon 26 Oct 2026, BUYER card, series Buying In This Market episode 2 (months of supply in plain words). Source READ 23 Oct 2026: Simply List Atlanta county statistics (Multiple Listing Service data), series "supply" for September 2026 vs September 2025: Henry 6.8 vs 5.3, Clayton 5.3 vs 4.4, Rockdale 5.1 vs 5.3, Newton 5.4 vs 4.9, Fayette 9.1 vs 6.1, Spalding 6.3 vs 5.4. Months of supply = how long it would take to sell the homes for sale at the current pace of sales (standard definition, not a figure). No verdict, no prediction.
headline:
Buying In South Metro
What Months Of Supply Means
turn_1: Echo, months of supply is how long it would take to sell every home for sale at today's pace. Henry County was at 6.8 months in September.
turn_3: A year earlier it was 5.3. Clayton, Newton, Fayette and Spalding were also higher than last year. Rockdale was about the same.
echo_line: More months of supply? …Oh. That means more homes out there. I'd look at a few before I pick one.
source: Multiple Listing Service via Simply List Atlanta · September 2026 · read October 23, 2026
disclaimer: General market information for six South Metro counties, not advice about any home or purchase. Numbers change month to month.
